description: A WinUI 3 page inside a NavigationView needs the main window HWND for a FileSavePicker, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/71432263/how-to-retrieve-the-window-handle-of-the-current-winui-3-mainwindow-from-a-page.
prompt: My save dialog works from MainWindow but not from ReportsPage inside a NavigationView. I tried casting Application.Current.MainWindow and then WinRT.Interop.WindowNative.GetWindowHandle(this), but the page is not a window and the picker fails.
